arithmetic: identical to fresh T retained path (per-tile softmax, alpha-scaled BF16 P, log-space retained mass, oldscale rescale): bit-identical to fresh T output on fresh T support
empty_rows: a row with no kept legal entry returns 0 output and -inf lse (same as the Triton consumer contract)
entry: support_consumer_sm90 (C ABI) / torch.ops.vd_support_v1.attention (ATen, namespace disjoint from value_direction_hopper)
gqa: per query head decisions; kv head = head // (H/HK) only for K/V addressing

inputs.legality: query-relative window (key >= q + (K-Q) - window + 1) when window>0, else optional packed uint64 row mask [B,1|H,Q,KT]
inputs.q: BF16 [B,H,Q,D] strided, last dim contiguous, 16B-aligned rows

outputs.counters: optional int32 [B,H,2*QB,4]: K tiles loaded, QK tiles, V tiles loaded, PV tiles (executed-path)
outputs.invalid: bool [B,H,Q]: NaN/+inf among legal retained scores; row output zeroed
outputs.lse: FP32 [B,H,Q] retained log mass (-inf if none/invalid)
outputs.output: BF16, layout 0 [B,H,Q,D] or layout 1 [B,Q,H,D] storage (model layout; no transpose copy)

ownership: maps are produced by the caller (route_only) on the same stream before the call; the kernel never writes them (tested)
pipeline: producer warpgroup (K cp.async + QK WGMMA + softmax + P) / 1-2 PV warpgroups (V cp.async + PV WGMMA); both test the same support entry before any work; one non-aligned barrier.sync hand-off per KEPT tile; P/scale double-buffered by kept ordinal; non-TMA cp.async bring-up (fresh-T baseline keeps TMA)
semantics: O = softmax(current transformed QK over KEPT(eligible&&!skipped) AND legal entries) @ current V; per query head; Q128xKV64 grid
